scope: CPU classical reverse-delete/refill strong control; proxy only, no novelty/quality/capacity claim
order: ascending sum_q(score_q / original_selected_score_q), stable token index tie-break
refill: each affected request takes its next highest scoring active optional position; protect first4/last32; keep fixed k
numerical_guard: Accumulated loss above epsilon*original*(1+1e-12) rejects immediately; within relative 1e-12 of boundary, independently recompute actual candidate score via fsum and require both loss <= epsilon*original and loss/original <= epsilon; final actual masks revalidated independently. This floating implementation is not an exact optimizer.
zero_loss: strict top-k natural cases return original masks after verifying exact per-request optimal topk; no zero-loss compute efficiency claim
stopping: one frozen pass; no post-outcome iteration/order selection
inputs: same three suffix_v2 rank0 layer15 captures and 4096/16384 budgets/all2heads as exchange screen; only pooled scores and supports consumed
limits: CPU wall timeout 1200 seconds; all failure/partial states retained
